tagline: For when you’re too lazy to cast a line but still want to brag about your catch. This drone lets you fish from your couch, complete with underwater cam so you can watch your bait get stolen by a seagull. Perfect for ‘reeling in’ that promotion you’re definitely not qualified for.

title: VW Beetle on Steroids
tagline: For the eccentric billionaire who needs to transport 8 friends to a vintage-themed prom, this 1969 VW Beetle limo is a thing. Because nothing says 'classy' like a stretched Beetle.

title: Hobbit Hole Heatwave
tagline: When your Dungeons & Dragons group insists on 'immersive' camping trips, but you refuse to freeze your toes off. This fire pit turns your backyard into the Shire—minus the orcs and plus a hefty mortgage payment. Perfect for toasting marshmallows while debating whether Gandalf would prefer s'mores or pipe weed.

title: Thrusters for Clumsy Bikers
tagline: Because you need help staying upright, these jet thrusters attach to your motorcycle, saving you from embarrassing spills on date nights or during ill-advised pizza delivery attempts.

title: Crow Wings of Desperation
tagline: For when you need to dramatically exit a bad date or reenact a goth teenager's prom entrance, these giant movable crow wings are oddly perfect.

title: Glowing Fungi For Misfits
tagline: Because your dinner party needed glowing mushrooms, these bitter oysters will thrive in the dimly lit corner of your eccentric aunt's basement, next to the taxidermied owl.

title: Trump's TP Rants
tagline: For when you need a reminder of his tweets with every wipe, because your morning routine wasn't weird enough already.

title: Gaming Pod of Excess
tagline: Because your living room needed a $10,000 egg to isolate you from humanity while gaming, now you can pay to be alone in style.

title: Bond Villain’s Brunch Box
tagline: For when your yacht’s minibar just isn’t *yacht* enough. This hamper comes with a gold-plated shaker, diamond-encrusted ice cubes, and a cocktail recipe book bound in sharkskin—because your guests deserve to sip like they’re plotting world domination. Perfect for that awkward moment when you realize your penthouse party is missing a touch of *class*.

title: Wear This, Forget Rent
tagline: Because who needs a mortgage when you can live in a post-apocalyptic wasteland? This Fallout T45D Power Armor Costume is perfect for your next 'I'm not drunk, I'm just surviving' party. Ideal for crushing soda cans, intimidating your cat, or pretending you're the only sane one left on Earth. Just don't try to wear it to a job interview.

title: HAL 2.0: Your Passive-Aggressive AI Overlord
tagline: Finally, an AI that judges you as harshly as your cat. Perfect for those late-night existential crises where you need someone—er, something—to remind you that your life choices led you to asking a glowing orb for advice. Bonus: It won’t eat your snacks, but it might just shut the pod bay doors on your productivity.

title: Drone With a Side of Robot
tagline: Ever needed to deliver a pizza to a second-story balcony but didn’t want to risk your drone’s dignity? This robotic arm-equipped drone is your knight in shiny, propelled armor. Perfect for the lazy landlord who wants to evict tenants without setting foot outside—or the overzealous pet owner who insists on aerial treat delivery. Just don’t blame it when your cat starts expecting gourmet sushi.

title: Galactic Midlife Crisis
tagline: Because your 40th birthday isn't complete without a motorcycle shaped like a spaceship, presumably to flee the responsibilities of adulthood.

title: Cluckin' Walkies Ahead
tagline: For that one aunt who insists on taking her chicken, Mr. Cluckers, on a stroll around the block, this harness and leash set is a must. Because what's a Sunday afternoon without a poultry parade?

title: Eight Figure Toy
tagline: Because your midtown parking spot deserves a $19M hypercar, especially when you're just grabbing a coffee.

title: Jedi Nightstick: For When Your Lightsaber Has a Guard Dog
tagline: Because nothing says 'I’m a serious Sith' like a lightsaber with a built-in handguard. Perfect for when you’re dueling in a crowded bar and need to make sure you don’t accidentally slice off your own hand while trying to impress that one droid who’s been giving you the eye.

title: McLuxury: Burger Bling
tagline: For the fast-food enthusiast who took 'supersize me' too literally. This 18K gold Big Mac ring is perfect for proposing at the drive-thru or sealing a deal with your accountant after a particularly profitable quarter. Just don't wear it while eating—no one wants gold-plated sesame seeds.
